reviews.review:
I just discovered a hidden gem of a game, and OMG why did no one tell me about this sooner?! Imagine Stardew Valley… but you’re not just farming you’re running an entire Edwardian-inspired village like some cute, cozy dictator. You can even start a cult if you’re feeling ✨spicy✨. And yes, you get to decorate your villagers’ houses too, because interior design is life. 💖

The farming? Stress-free.
The animal care? Adorable.
The mining? Addictive to the point that “one more run” becomes 3 hours.
The fishing? Finally a fishing mini-game that doesn’t make me cry.
Has mini games
Hopefully, there would be a plan for festivals and holiday 💖

There are so many quests, and romance is coming soon! Even though it’s still early access, I barely encountered any bugs like, this game is more stable than my mental health.

I can’t wait for the full release. Plus, the dev is super active and friendly on Discord. Love it so much 😭💖
